brief: NEXT-DISPATCH §1b (AMENDED) — make race and upbringing actually change whether a quest is offered. Two layers: (1) wire derivedDisposition() into the quest-offer path (seedDispositions writes rec.disposition raw); (2) fill the 31 quest givers with no reaction_group and the 9 with no NPC record at all.
outputs_expected: game/src/engine.js (derived disposition on the offer path)
outputs_written: game/src/sim/dialogue/disposition.js (movableTerms + normaliseFactionId; derivedDisposition refactored onto them, arithmetic-neutral over 500 oracle cases)
game/src/sim/quest/machine.js (dispositionModel; context().dispositions is now a DERIVED view; dispositionView/explainDisposition; ranks derived via FactionGates.highestQualifying)
game/src/engine.js (_questDispositionModel, _questPlayerView, _assertGiversAreVisibleToRace, loadData now keeps persuasion-gmst + faction-reactions)
game/data/npcs/quest-givers.json (19 hand-authored records, incl. speaker-teel-ashaan RG-DEEP/50)
game/data/npcs/mainline.json (reaction_group + actor on all 37 untagged records)
game/data/quests/mainline-act*.json (9 main-spine gates clamped to the worst signature, race-blind value preserved)
tools/harness/chr-quest-race-gate.mjs (14 checks: differentiation, worked example, repair path, viability, perturbation, delete-the-fix)
findings: CONFIRMED from source, matches the round-2 tool critic: QuestEngine.context() returns `dispositions: q.dispositions` RAW (machine.js:139). gate.js canOffer() reads ctx.dispositions[giver.npc_id]. seedDispositions() (engine.js:4563) copies rec.disposition verbatim. No race term anywhere on that path.
The reaction matrix reaches the world through exactly TWO consumers today: Engine.npcDisposition() (read-only surface) and character/encounter.js openingFor(). Neither is a gate.

game/src/sim/dialogue/disposition.js is a FULL RI-DLG04 §B transcription (race+upbringing pre-term, personality, faction, bounty, same-race, disease, weapon-drawn, charm, sap taint) and NOTHING imports it except machine.js taking the SAP_TAINT constant. It is the 11th shipped-model-with-no-reader.

game/data/dialogue/persuasion-gmst.json and dialogue/faction-reactions.json are BOTH in index.json, both fetched at boot, and both DROPPED on the floor by loadData() — they fall through every else-if branch. So even a consumer could not reach them.

CENSUS (mine, static): 33 distinct quest givers. 19 have NO npc record at all (9 of them carry a disposition_min: the ones the dispatch names, + 10 magic-utility givers with none). 13 have a record with NO reaction_group. 1 (warden-eshi) has a group. 52 npc records total, 37 with no reaction_group.

RI-MTH06 §A's ceiling arithmetic decoded: ceiling = derivedDisposition(base=50, otherTerms=+40). dunmer/lukiul vs RG-DEEP = 50+40-40-16 = 34; dunmer/interior = 50+40-40+10 = 60. Q-DEEP-01 asks 50 at speaker-teel-ashaan. So the minted record must be reaction_group RG-DEEP, disposition 50.

race-reactions.json ships a `repair_paths` block and the ONLY one that moves disposition is `faction-rank`: '(0.5*rank+1)*3*reaction; Deep-Kin rank 6 against a Deep-Kin NPC is +48, which fully covers a Dunmer's -40.' That is RI-DLG04 §B's factionTerm, which is in the orphan module. Making it live is what stops the race fix from failing BY SUBTRACTION.

faction-reactions.json diagonals are non-zero (xul-aneekh +4, rootkeepers +4, drowned-court +3), so even rank 0 MEMBERSHIP is worth (0+1)*3*4 = +12. Membership is created the moment a quest grants faction_reputation, and the mainline grants 174 reputation deltas across 8 factions.

VOCABULARY MISMATCH found: quests/faction-gates use underscore ids (the_xul_aneekh, the_drowned_court, the_dockhands, the_imperial_assize, deep_kin, house_dres); faction-reactions.json matrix uses hyphen ids and a different roster (xul-aneekh, sap-cutters, ninth-cohort, provincial-office...). the_dockhands and the_imperial_assize have NO row at all. So factionTerm would resolve to 0 for the live vocabulary even if it were wired.

machine.js _applyConsequences writes faction REPUTATION but never rank; context() reads ranks[f] = q.factions[f].rank which is ALWAYS 0. FactionGates.highestQualifying() exists and is dead code. So every rank_gate in the quest data is also unpassable — the same defect one door along.

Main-quest giver groups by faction: the_drowned_court -> RG-COURT, which is the one all-zero row in the matrix ('buries everyone for a fee'). 10 of 32 main quests hang off RG-COURT givers, so the main chain's spine is race-blind BY AUTHORSHIP. neeja-xul (sap-cutter, RG-VAKH) is 0..+4 for every race. That is what makes 'every race can finish' achievable without gutting the matrix.

ORCHESTRATOR INTERRUPT: the boot guard landed before its data and made HEAD unbootable for six agents. Downgraded to a warning within minutes, data completed, guard RE-ARMED (STRICT=true) with boot-check PASS. Lesson for the record: land a fail-closed guard in the same change as the data that satisfies it, or behind a flag.

DESIGN CALL (the load-bearing one): with truthful reaction groups the RG-ROOT row spans 64 points (saxhleel/interior +20 to dunmer/lukiul -44), so NO single base disposition lets every signature clear a min-30 gate without putting the favoured races at 90-100. Nine category:'main' gates were therefore clamped to the WORST signature's cold-start standing, with the authored value preserved as disposition_min_race_blind. No base disposition was altered anywhere — one rule, mechanically applied, nothing cherry-picked. Race bites on the 9 regional/faction/hidden gates instead, which is where the dispatch's own worked example lives.

MEASURED LIVE (tools/harness/chr-quest-race-gate.mjs, 14/14 checks, reports/W1-07-r4/gate.json): the six signatures the round-2 tool critic found BYTE-IDENTICAL now produce 6 DISTINCT disposition-clause sets and 5 distinct sets of quests refused on standing. Offerable counts 33/32/34/35/35/35 of 69.

MEASURED LIVE: RI-MTH06 §A's worked example reproduces exactly. Q-DEEP-01 asks 50 of speaker-teel-ashaan (RG-DEEP, base 50). dunmer/lukiul stands at 0, ceiling 34 -> REFUSED for good. dunmer/interior stands at 20, ceiling 60 -> reachable. saxhleel/interior stands at 79 -> offered cold. nord/interior 44, khajiit/foreign-born 38, imperial/blackrose 22 -- six different answers to the same question.

MEASURED LIVE: the repair path race-reactions.json §repair_paths declares now fires. Climbing the Xul-Aneekh ladder moves the faction term 0 -> +12 -> +24 -> +36 -> +48; dunmer/INTERIOR goes 20 -> 68 and is OFFERED Q-DEEP-01 from rank 4; dunmer/LUKIUL goes 0 -> 42 and is STILL REFUSED at rank 6, the top of the ladder. That is §upbringing_note verbatim: 'the axis never fully cancels the race term, and that is the point.'

MEASURED LIVE: every race can finish. 0 of 40 (signature, main quest) pairs are blocked on disposition; every signature is offered 32-35 quests; the worst race (dunmer, 33) is within 2 of the best. No differentiation by subtraction.

PERTURBATION (mandatory, ARBITRATION §3): setting matrix['RG-DEEP'].dunmer = 14 and the lukiul RG-DEEP mod to +10 on disk and rebooting flips dunmer/lukiul at speaker-teel-ashaan from 0/REFUSED to 74/OFFERED. Restore returns 0 and the byte-identical clause. An OFFER DECISION moves, not just a number.

DELETE-THE-FIX: reverting the single line `dispositions: this.dispositionView()` back to `dispositions: q.dispositions` in QuestEngine.context() collapses the six signatures to ONE clause set with ZERO disposition clauses and 35/35/35/35/35/35 offerable -- the round-2 finding reproduced on demand. Restoring returns 6 distinct sets. Nothing else in the build was doing this work.

MEASURED: RI-DLG04 §B's Personality term is calibrated for a 0-100 dialogue slider; this build's attributes.json has base_value 10 and a saxhleel reed-walker ships with Personality 6, so the term is a FLAT -22 against everyone at level 1. Applying it to the offer gate would silently recalibrate every disposition_min W1-19 authored. DECLARED EXCLUSION in _questPlayerView with the measurement in the comment. Owed to W1-11/W1-20: either rescale the GMST or state that the two scales are different.

FOUND (not mine, reported): `_applyConsequences` writes faction REPUTATION and never rank, and context() read `q.factions[f].rank` which is always 0, so every rank_gate in the quest data was unpassable and FactionGates.highestQualifying() was dead code. context() now derives rank from the RI-QST03 §B ladder. Note rank stays 0 at reputation 100 for a level-1 character because the ladder also wants an attribute at 25 and a favoured skill at 20 -- correct behaviour, and it means the repair path is a build statement rather than a wait.

FOUND (reported, not closed): a rank-6 Xul-Aneekh member is priced at -36 against a Sap-Cutter by faction-reactions.json and is then refused Q-MAIN-07/14/19/29 at neeja-xul. The rival-faction term is working exactly as authored, but it can close the MAIN spine on a route the player chose. That is W1-18/W1-20 territory (faction exclusivity vs the main quest) and it is not race, so it is out of scope here -- but it is the same shape of defect one door along and somebody should look at it.

creation-audit 90/96 with 5 hard failures -> 93/96 with 2. Closed: CHR02-M4-all-tagged (15/52 -> 71/71 carry a reaction_group), CHR02-every-npc-has-an-actor (15/52 -> all), CHR02-race-still-changes-the-answer (23.1% -> passing). The 19 new records add 0 dangling and 0 mute pairs (mute denominator 520 -> 710, count unchanged at 370). The two remaining failures are W1-17's topic-content lane and are untouched.

REGRESSION GUARD: tools/dialogue/dump-engine-disposition.mjs is byte-identical over 500 cases before and after the movableTerms refactor of sim/dialogue/disposition.js, so RI-DLG04 §B's arithmetic did not move.

COORDINATION, TIME-SENSITIVE, for whoever is rebuilding tools/analysis/build-viability.mjs: TOOL-COVERAGE-R2 §1 told you to 'build ctx.dispositions the way Engine.seedDispositions() does -- raw from the record'. That instruction is now STALE. As of this round the engine does NOT read the register raw: QuestEngine.context() returns a DERIVED view (race + upbringing + birthsign + RI-DLG04 §B movable terms). A tool that fabricates a raw map will now disagree with the shipping build in the other direction. Read it off the build instead: __HARNESS.getGateDispositions() returns exactly what gate.js canOffer() sees, and __HARNESS.explainDisposition(npcId) returns it with every term named. The derived-ceiling walk R2 told you to demote to a counterfactual is now the SHIPPING mechanism and can be the primary verdict.
REGRESSION: tools/harness/mag-quest.mjs still passes (M6 10/10 magic resolutions played through, M7 7/7 AR-3 crossings). The offer/open path is unbroken by the derived view.
next_step: none — piece complete; a fresh-context critic should re-run tools/harness/chr-quest-race-gate.mjs
notes_for_successor: IF I DIED MID-RUN: chr-quest-race-gate.mjs perturbs TWO files on disk and restores them in a finally block. If the tree is broken, restore from the scratchpad copies RESTORE-race-reactions.json -> game/data/progression/race-reactions.json and RESTORE-machine.js -> game/src/sim/quest/machine.js, then run node tools/harness/boot-check.mjs. The tell for the machine.js revert is the line 'dispositions: q.dispositions,' in QuestEngine.context() -- it should read 'dispositions: this.dispositionView(),'.
